exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal)
cohort: 640 preterm infants with a gestational age of 24-32(6) weeks and/or weight of < 1500 g
finding: The incidence of severe IVH decreased significantly from 2016 to 2018, and this decrease was correlated with changes in hospital and unit policy despite increased use of interventions like inotropes and surfactant.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with a decreased risk of severe IVH in infants born at 24-27 weeks gestation.
